svg.title: FP16 versus BF16 bit layout
svg.desc: Both formats use 16 bits. FP16 uses five exponent and ten fraction bits for finer precision. BF16 uses eight exponent and seven fraction bits for a much wider numeric range.

g.text: MORE RANGE: max finite is about 3.39e38
Finer values, but easier to overflow or underflow
Coarser values, but fewer overflow and underflow problems
Same model size. Choose precision or dynamic range.
